dialogues.speaker: Yantasar
dialogues.text: Freshly squeezed with the finest fruits and balanced with the most mysterious spices for the richest flavor you could possibly conceive of!

dialogues.speaker: Yantasar
dialogues.text: And once you've tasted it, there's no going back! You'll feel like you've had all the world's blessings bestowed upon you by the Wayob, as light as a Qucusaurus feather floating up into the clouds...
